About us

The foundation stone of Indira Gandhi Rashtriya Uran Akademi, commonly called IGRUA, was laid by the then Hon'ble Prime Minister of India, Late Capt Rajiv Gandhi on 07 November 1985.
The Governing Council -
The Akademi functions under the Ministry of Civil Aviation (MoCA), Govt. of India (GOI) through its Governing Council (GC).

Read More

Shri Murlidhar Mohol

Hon’ble Minister of State for Civil Aviation

Salient Features

  • A Premier institute under Government of India specially created to improve training standards of pilot aspirants.
  • Over two decades of quality training record in the industry.
  • A mix of highly experienced flying instructors with years of instructional experience in civil/military flying.
  • An optimum student/ instructor/ aircraft ratio maintained with the strictest adherence to safety both on ground and in the air.
  • Swimming Pool and Auditorium with well designed Acoustics and latest equipments.

Indira Gandhi Rashtriya Uran Akademi (IGRUA) located at Fursatganj District Amethii Uttar Pradesh, is an autonomous body under the control of the Ministry of Civil Aviation. The Governing Council is the suprem e body of the organization headed by the Secretary, Ministry of Civil Aviation.The chairman and members are: Sr. No. Name Designation 1. Shri Deepak Kumar Addl Chief Secretary & DG, Civil Aviation, Government of Uttar Prades h Ex - Officio Member 10. Air Cmde Vipul Singh, AVSM VM (Retd) Director, Indira Gandhi Rashtriya Uran Akademi Ex - Officio Member The Akademi is headed by a Director who is assiste d by Departmental heads of Operations, Services, Finance and HR. The foreign nationals from Afghanistan, Royal Nepal Airlines, Mauritius, Zambia and Seachelleous have also undergon e Pilot Training at IGRUA. The Refresher courses for all Chief Flying Instructors / Pilot Instructor Incharge of flying clubs are conducted regularly. The Pilot training to candida tes of Indian Airlines, BSF, Coast Guard candidates, Indian Air Force and Indian Navy is also provided by IGRUA as and when required. Over 275 students are undergoing training at p resent and we are continuously making efforts to increase seats every year. IGRUA remains an epitome of standardization and excellence in flying training thus becoming the first ch oice for airlines when they select pilots for their company. IGRUA is becoming a knowledge and skill development hub of civil aviation. National Aviation University long with Hoste ls, Staff quarters at IGRUA complex has become fully operational and various courses in airport management, airport operations and fire fighting are being conducted. The IGRUA AME School has been approved and admissions have begun. IGRUA provides on-the-job training to candidates under-going AME in various Indian private institutes.
